facts.business: Sun TV Network Limited is one of India's largest television broadcasters operating satellite TV channels across seven languages, FM radio stations, an IPL franchise (SunRisers Hyderabad), a digital OTT platform (Sun NXT), and international sports assets including SunRisers Eastern Cape and SunRisers Leeds Limited.

capacity_or_capex.item: Commitments for acquisition of film and program broadcasting rights, Production and distribution related rights
